status: design-rule-only; no confirmatory pilot, simulation receipt, or selected seed count exists
scope: H1, H2, H3, H4, H5, H6a, H6b, H7, and H8 only; E03 qualification has its separate four-row rule
ambiguity: The statistical policy's 'largest required primary-seed count' can be read as choosing the largest qualifying candidate, while the allocation policy requires the smallest shared qualifying candidate.
resolution: A member-specific minimum is diagnostic only. The controlling choice is the first ordered shared candidate whose complete nine-member joint-decision simulation passes the lower-bound gate. The maximum of member-specific minima does not replace that joint gate.
monteCarloInterval: two-sided 95% Wilson on complete joint-decision successes
completeDecision: Each simulated repetition succeeds only when all nine frozen member-specific tests, composite directions and practical margins, validity/missingness rules, and the global Holm procedure succeed together.
unmetGate: If no listed candidate passes, no confirmatory seed prefix may be registered; investigate the design and resource envelope prospectively without relaxing margins or fabricating results.
registrationGate: Bind every member's frozen raw-scale margin, blinded-pilot upper variance, exact test/simulation implementation, 30000-repetition receipt, selected shared prefix, ordered reserves, and measured resource allocation before confirmatory collection.
claimBoundary: Clarifies a future selection rule only. It is not a power simulation, pilot measurement, authorized resource expansion, scientific finding, or independent review.
